name: Nippon Light Metal Holdings Company, Ltd.
summary: Nippon Light Metal Holdings Company, Ltd. manufactures and sells aluminum products and related products in Japan and internationally. The company operates in four segments: Alumina, Chemical products, Bullion; Plate, Extruded products; Processed products and related businesses; and Foil and Powder Products Business. It develops and manufactures various chemicals, including alumina and aluminum hydroxide, as well as aluminum alloys; aluminum sheet metal and extruded aluminum profiles, and supplies to various fields.
